names.note: Name page 13749 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Константин (Богоявленский), иерей, сщмч.»; the grade «иерей» and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, as BRIEF-RUSSIAN asks, the day line itself giving only «Константина пресвитера». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE: the corpus keeps six Bogoyavlensky folders and no Constantine among them.

death.note: The day line closes «(1918)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 14 июля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Константина пресвитера (1918).»

attestations.note: The day's eighth entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page behind it. «иерей» on the name page is the priestly grade and «пресвитера» on the line the same word, so `presbyter` and the office `Priest` are read and not assumed; `Priest` is a string the four locale packs already carry. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar's twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries, and THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE OF THE NEW MARTYRS WAS NOT OPENED. No folder held him. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
